title: Average sperm concentration, 1973 vs 2018 (million per mL)
geography: Global (pooled, men not known to be infertile)

source.name: Temporal trends in sperm count (Levine et al., meta-analysis of 223 studies)

notes: Meta-analysis of 223 studies, 53 countries, 1973-2018. Average sperm concentration fell from about 101 million per mL to about 49 million per mL, a decline of roughly 52%.
